'''Zaccharie Risacher''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|z|æ|k|ər|i|_|ˌ|r|iː|z|ɑː|ˈ|ʃ|eɪ}} {{respell|ZAK|ər|ee|_|REE|zah|SHAY}}; {{IPA|fr|zakaʁi ʁizaʃe}};<ref>{{cite AV media|title=2 minutes avec Zaccharie Risacher|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R0MmtX8PYWE|publisher=[[JL Bourg Basket|JL Bourg]]|date=17 June 2023|time=00:00:04|via=[[YouTube]]}}</ref> born 8 April 2005) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Dallas Mavericks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He was selected with the [[List of first overall NBA draft picks|first overall pick]] by the Atlanta Hawks in the [[2024 NBA draft]].

==Early life==
Risacher was born on 8 April 2005, in [[Málaga]], Spain, where his father, [[Stéphane Risacher]], played professional basketball for [[Baloncesto Málaga]] from 2002 to 2006.<ref>{{cite web |date=28 February 2022 |title=Zaccharie Risacher, el malagueño de 16 años que ya juega en Euroliga |trans-title=Zaccharie Risacher, the 16-year-old from Malaga who already plays in the Euroleague |url=https://www.malagahoy.es/unicaja/Zaccharie-Risacher-malagueno-juega-Euroliga_0_1660634276.html |access-date=23 February 2023 |work=Málaga Hoy |language=es}}</ref> His family moved back to [[Lyon]], France, where he started playing club basketball at Élan Chalon at the age of three and a half, at youth club Tassin in the suburbs of the city.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-06-01 |title=Risacher trying to follow in father's footsteps {{!}} Adidas Next Generation theTournament |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/ngt/news/risacher-trying-to-follow-in-fathers-footsteps/ |access-date=4 April 2024 |website=Euroleague Basketball |language=en-GB |archive-date=26 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231126193518/https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/ngt/news/risacher-trying-to-follow-in-fathers-footsteps/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Zaccharie Risacher, des premiers pas encourageants pour le dernier "fils de" du basket français |trans-title=Zaccharie Risacher, encouraging first steps for the last "son of" French basketball |language=fr |url=https://www.basketusa.com/news/629732/zaccharie-risacher-des-premiers-pas-encourageants-pour-le-dernier-fils-de-du-basket-francais/ |date=6 January 2021 |work=Basket USA |access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref>

Risacher entered the youth program of [[ASVEL Basket]] in August 2020. He primarily played for the club's youth team in LNB Espoirs, the French under-21 league.<ref>{{cite web |title=Basket : Zacharie Risacher, phénomène en éclosion à l'ASVEL |trans-title=Basketball: Zacharie Risacher, emerging phenomenon at ASVEL |date=8 February 2022 |first=Etienne |last=Le Van Ky |work=Sportmag |access-date=27 June 2024 |language=fr |url=https://www.sportmag.fr/basket-zacharie-risacher-phenomene-en-eclosion-a-lasvel/}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===LDLC ASVEL (2021–2024)===
Risacher made his debut with ASVEL's senior team in 2021, in a [[LNB Élite]] match against [[Metropolitans 92]].<ref>{{cite web |date=6 February 2022 |title=Zaccharie Risacher (ASVEL): "Il ne faut jamais se reposer sur ses lauriers" |url=https://www.lequotidiendusport.fr/zaccharie-risacher-gratter-des-minutes-avec-lasvel/ |access-date=22 February 2023 |work=Le Quotidien du Sport |language=fr}}</ref> He also made his [[EuroLeague]] debut later in the season, on 18 January 2022, in a 75–100 loss to [[AS Monaco Basket|Monaco]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Carton |first=Clement |date=18 January 2022 |title=Euroleague: Monaco prend sa revanche sur l'ASVEL à l'Astroballe! |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/584013/euroleague-monaco-prend-sa-revanche-sur-lasvel-a-lastroballe/ |access-date=23 February 2023 |website=BasketEurope.com |language=fr}}</ref> He averaged 12.5 points and 4.4 rebounds per game in the LNB Espoirs competition.<ref>{{cite web |date=2 July 2022 |title=Zaccharie Risacher, el segundo malagueño en el Mundial sub 17 |url=https://www.malagahoy.es/unicaja/Zaccharie-Risacher-segundo-malagueno-Mundial_0_1698130948.html |access-date=23 February 2023 |work=Málaga Hoy |language=es}}</ref>

=== JL Bourg (2023–2024) ===
On 16 June 2023, Risacher signed his first professional contract with ASVEL, before being immediately loaned out to fellow first-tier club [[JL Bourg Basket|JL Bourg]] for the 2023–24 season.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zaccharie Risacher signs his first pro contract with ASVEL, but is sent out on loan |url=https://basketnews.com/news-190816-zaccharie-risacher-signs-his-first-pro-contract-with-asvel-but-is-sent-out-on-loan.html |website=basketnews.com |access-date=6 January 2024 |date=16 June 2023}}</ref> On 29 November 2023, he was named to Team France for the [[LNB All-Star Game]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 November 2023 |title=All Star Game LNB 2023 : les All Stars et les participants aux concours sont connus ! |url=https://www.lnb.fr/elite/all-star-game-lnb-2023-les-all-stars-et-les-participants-aux-concours-sont-connus/ |access-date=25 February 2024 |website=Betclic ELITE |language=fr}}</ref>

Internationally, Risacher featured for JL Bourg in the [[2023–24 EuroCup Basketball|2023–24 EuroCup]], where the team eventually reached the [[2024 EuroCup Finals|Finals]],<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=22 April 2024 |title=Projected No. 1 pick Risacher to enter NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39995286 |access-date=27 April 2024 |website=[[ESPN]]}}</ref><ref name=":02">{{Cite news |date=27 June 2024 |title=NBA Draft: French players Risacher, Sarr and Salaün make history in New York |url=https://www.lemonde.fr/en/sports/article/2024/06/27/france-s-risacher-chosen-by-hawks-with-top-pick-in-nba-draft_6675885_9.html |access-date=27 June 2024 |work=[[Le Monde]]}}</ref> before losing to fellow French side [[Paris Basketball]].<ref name=":02"/> In April, Risacher was awarded the [[EuroCup Rising Star]] prize; at the age of 18 years and 362 days, he became the second-youngest player to win the award, being just a month older than [[Džanan Musa]], who had won the award in [[2017–18 EuroCup Basketball|2018]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=5 April 2024 |title=BKT EuroCup Rising Star winner: Zaccharie Risacher, Bourg |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/eurocup/news/bkt-eurocup-rising-star-winner-zaccharie-risacher-bourg/ |access-date=10 April 2024 |website=Euroleague Basketball |language=en-GB |archive-date=16 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240416180818/https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/eurocup/news/bkt-eurocup-rising-star-winner-zaccharie-risacher-bourg/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

On 12 May 2024, Risacher was named the [[LNB Pro A Best Young Player|Best Young Player]] of the [[2023–24 LNB Élite season]], having averaged 10.1 points and 3.8 rebounds in 22 minutes per game.<ref name=":02"/>'''<ref>{{Cite web |date=13 May 2024 |title=Trophées LNB 2024 : les lauréats en Betclic ELITE |url=https://www.lnb.fr/elite/trophees-lnb-2024-les-laureats-en-betclic-elite/ |access-date=15 May 2024 |website=Betclic ELITE |language=fr}}</ref>'''

===Atlanta Hawks (2024–2026)===
On 22 April 2024, Risacher announced that he had declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]];<ref name=":2"/> his entry was confirmed by the [[NBA]] on 2 May.<ref>{{cite web|title=NBA announces early entry candidates for NBA Draft 2024|url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-draft-2024-early-entry-candidates|website=NBA.com|date=2 May 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref>

==== 2024–25 season ====
On 26 June 2024, Risacher was selected by the [[Atlanta Hawks]] with the [[List of first overall NBA draft picks|first overall pick]] in the 2024 NBA draft.<ref name=":02"/><ref name=":3">{{cite web |last=Bontemps |first=Tim |date=27 June 2024 |title=Hawks use No. 1 pick on France's Risacher, 19 |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40440314 |access-date=27 June 2024 |website=ESPN.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite magazine|title=Atlanta Hawks Select Zaccharie Risacher No. 1 Overall at 2024 NBA Draft|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/atlanta-hawks-select-zaccharie-risacher-no-1-overall-at-2024-nba-draft|magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref> In the process, he became the second consecutive French player to be drafted with the number one pick, after [[San Antonio Spurs]] had picked [[Victor Wembanyama]] in the [[2023 NBA draft|previous year's draft]];<ref name=":02"/><ref name=":3"/><ref name="Delafolie">{{cite web|first=Gaëtan|last=Delafolie|title=Risacher et Sarr au sommet, Salaün dans le top 10 : draft NBA historique pour la France|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Risacher-n-1-sarr-n-2-draft-nba-historique-pour-la-france/1477805|website=[[L'Équipe]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024|language=fr-FR}}</ref> furthermore, he became the 6th international player to be taken with the first selection, after Wembanyama himself, [[Andrea Bargnani]] (in [[2006 NBA draft|2006]]), [[Andrew Bogut]] (in [[2005 NBA draft|2005]]), [[Yao Ming]] (in [[2002 NBA draft|2002]]) and [[Hakeem Olajuwon]] (in [[1984 NBA draft|1984]]). Risacher was selected alongside fellow Frenchmen [[Alex Sarr]] (drafted by the [[Washington Wizards]] with the second pick) and [[Tidjane Salaün]] (drafted by the [[Charlotte Hornets]] with the sixth pick), making France the first foreign nation to have at least three native players picked in the top 10 spots of any NBA draft.<ref name=":02"/><ref name="Delafolie"/>

On 6 July 2024, Risacher signed with the Hawks<ref>{{cite web |date=6 July 2024 |title=Atlanta Hawks Sign No. 1 Overall Pick Zaccharie Risacher |url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/news/atlanta-hawks-sign-no-1-overall-pick-zaccharie-risacher |access-date=14 July 2024 |website=NBA.com}}</ref> and six days later, he made his [[2024 NBA Summer League|NBA Summer League]] debut against the Washington Wizards, recording 18 points, five rebounds and two assists in a 94–88 loss.<ref>{{cite news |last=Williams |first=Lauren |date=13 July 2024 |title=Zaccharie Risacher makes pro debut in Hawks' Summer League loss |url=https://www.ajc.com/sports/atlanta-hawks/zaccharie-risacher-makes-pro-debut-in-hawks-summer-league-loss/WAJTVQEJ3FEEBP4MB6OFV6H7B4/ |access-date=13 July 2024 |work=The Atlanta Journal-Constitution |issn=1539-7459}}</ref> Risacher made his NBA regular-season debut on 23 October, recording seven points and one rebound in 19 minutes played in a 120–116 win over the [[Brooklyn Nets]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10140697-zaccharie-risacher-admits-nba-is-big-adjustment-after-struggles-in-hawks-debut|title=Zaccharie Risacher Admits NBA is 'Big Adjustment' After Struggles in Hawks Debut|website=Bleacher Report|last=Polacek|first=Scott|date=October 24, 2024|access-date=November 6, 2024}}</ref> On 6 November, Risacher put up a career-high 33 points in a 121–115 win over the [[New York Knicks]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/hawks-news-zaccharie-risacher-pulls-off-feat-not-seen-before-in-nba-history|title=Hawks' Zaccharie Risacher pulls off feat not seen before in NBA history|last=Pagaduan|first=Jedd|website=ClutchPoints|date=November 6, 2024|access-date=November 6, 2024}}</ref> On 30 March, 2025, Risacher scored a then career-high 36 points in a 145–124 win over the [[Milwaukee Bucks]]. He became the fourth 1st overall pick to record 35+ points, 5+ threes in a game as a rookie after [[Allen Iverson]], [[LeBron James]] and [[Anthony Edwards (basketball)|Anthony Edwards]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Kia Rookie Ladder: Stephon Castle closing in on award in final push |url=https://www.nba.com/news/kia-rookie-ladder-april-2-2025-edition|website=NBA.com|date=April 2, 2025|access-date=April 2, 2025}}</ref> On 10 April, Risacher put up a career-high 38 points in a 133–109 win over the Brooklyn Nets.<ref>{{cite web|title=Risacher scores season-high 38 points as Hawks beat Nets 133-109 |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401705735|publisher=NBA |agency=Associated Press|date=April 10, 2025|access-date=April 11, 2025}}</ref>

==== 2025–26 season ====
During his sophomore season, Risacher's playing time and usage decreased. On 7 January 2026, he put up a season-high 25 points, alongside eight rebounds, in a 117–100 win over the [[New Orleans Pelicans]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=HAWKS ROLL TO 117-110 VICTORY OVER PELICANS AS WORD OF TRAE YOUNG-TO-WIZARDS TRADE BREAKS |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022500519 |access-date=1 May 2026 |website=NBA.com}}</ref>

The Hawks faced the [[New York Knicks]] during their first-round playoff series. On 18 April, Risacher made his playoff debut for the Hawks, recording four rebounds in a 113–102 Game 1 loss.<ref>{{Cite web |title=BRUNSON AND TOWNS LEAD THE KNICKS PAST THE HAWKS 113-102 IN GAME 1 OF THEIR SERIES |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0042500121 |access-date=1 May 2026 |website=NBA.com}}</ref> The team would end up losing the series in six games, and Risacher played sparingly, averaging only 3.7 points per game in 7.7 minutes per game.

===Dallas Mavericks (2026–present)===
On 19 July 2026, Risacher was traded to the [[Dallas Mavericks]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Mavericks Acquire Zaccharie Rishacher |url=https://www.nba.com/mavs/news/mavericks-acquire-zaccharie-rishacher |website=NBA.com |access-date=July 19, 2026 |date=July 19, 2026}}</ref>

==National team career==
Risacher played for the [[France men's national under-17 basketball team|France under-17 basketball team]] at the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/looking-at-the-future-zaccharie-risacher|title=Looking at the Future: Zaccharie Risacher|first=Ignacio|last=Rissotto|website=[[SI.com]]|date=4 November 2022|access-date=22 February 2023}}</ref> He struggled with consistency during the tournament which culminated by a zero-point, five-turnover performance in the final against Spain.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=23 February 2024 |title=Next Big Thing: Why is Zaccharie Risacher projected as the #1 pick in the NBA draft? |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2025/qualifiers/news/next-big-thing-why-is-zaccharie-risacher-projected-as-the-1-pick-in-the-nba-draft |access-date=4 April 2024 |website=FIBA.basketball |language=en}}</ref> He averaged 10.4 points and 4.4 rebounds per game as France won the bronze medal.<ref>{{cite web |date=10 July 2022 |title=Les Bleuets décrochent le bronze à la Coupe du monde U17 contre la Lituanie |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Les-bleuets-decrochent-le-bronze-a-la-coupe-du-monde-u17-contre-la-lituanie/1342989 |access-date=23 February 2023 |work=[[L'Équipe]] |language=fr}}</ref>

Risacher debuted with the [[France men's national basketball team|France senior team]] on 23 February 2024 against [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatia]], but was forced to leave the game after four minutes due to a concussion.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-02-24 |title=Basket. 4 minutes et s'en va : une première en équipe de France oubliable pour Zaccharie Risacher |url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/equipe-de-france/basket-4-minutes-et-sen-va-une-premiere-en-equipe-de-france-oubliable-pour-zaccharie-risacher-bcf1536e-d29f-11ee-8d5b-fea85cc09741 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240224082230/https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/equipe-de-france/basket-4-minutes-et-sen-va-une-premiere-en-equipe-de-france-oubliable-pour-zaccharie-risacher-bcf1536e-d29f-11ee-8d5b-fea85cc09741 |archive-date=24 February 2024 |access-date=2025-09-08 |work=Ouest-France.fr |language=fr-FR |url-status=live }}</ref> He later re-joined France for their [[EuroBasket 2025]] qualifying games.<ref name=":0"/> He later made the final selection for EuroBasket 2025,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-08-17 |title=Les Bleus announce 12-man roster for FIBA EuroBasket 2025 |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-eurobasket-2025/news/les-bleus-announce-12-man-roster-for-fiba-eurobasket-2025 |access-date=2025-09-08 |website=www.fiba.basketball |language=en}}</ref> and averaged 9.7 points, 4.2 rebounds and 1.7 assists per game.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Zaccharie Risacher - France - Player Profile - FIBA EuroBasket 2025 {{!}} FIBA Basketball |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-eurobasket-2025/teams/france/300463-zaccharie-risacher |access-date=2025-09-08 |website=www.fiba.basketball |language=en}}</ref>

==Player profile==
Playing at [[small forward]], Risacher is a catch-and-shoot player and a shooter off screens or from mid-range.<ref name=":0"/> His versatility has been noted for his ability to defend both guards and forwards at times.<ref name=":0"/>

==Personal life==
Risacher is of [[Martiniquais people|Martiniquais]] descent through his father, [[Stéphane Risacher]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kagni |first=Guillaume |date=2 March 2025 |title=NBA - Zaccharie Risacher honnête sur sa relation avec la Martinique : « Fier d'être Martiniquais, mais... |url=https://www.parlons-basket.com/2025/03/02/nba-zaccharie-risacher-honnete-sur-sa-relation-avec-la-martinique-fier-detre-martiniquais-mais/}}</ref> Stéphane Risacher also played basketball professionally; he won a [[silver medal]] at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]] with the [[France men's national basketball team|France national team]].<ref name=":3"/><ref>{{cite web |date=10 February 2022 |title=EUROLIGUE. Zaccharie Risacher, l'autre pépite de l'Asvel |url=https://www.leprogres.fr/sport/2022/02/10/zaccharie-risacher-l-autre-pepite-de-l-asvel |access-date=22 February 2023 |work=[[Le Progrès]] |language=fr}}</ref> Risacher's younger sister, Aïnhoa Risacher, is also a professional basketball player, currently playing for the [[ASVEL Féminin|LDLC ASVEL Féminin]] of the [[Ligue Féminine de Basketball]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Spears |first=Marc J. |date=2024-07-15 |title=Atlanta Hawks No. 1 pick Zaccharie Risacher has always had basketball in his life |url=https://andscape.com/features/atlanta-hawks-no-1-pick-zaccharie-risacher-has-always-had-basketball-in-his-life/ |access-date=2024-12-25 |website=Andscape |language=en-US}}</ref>
